description: This file defines React components for navigation items in the Notesnook web application, including a standard navigation item and a sortable version, with associated styling, event handling, and external dependencies.

methods.name: NavigationItem
methods.description: React component for rendering a navigation item with optional icon, title, and menu interactions.
